prompt_text: What is the best home care agency in Pleasanton CA for an elderly parent?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agency—the right fit depends on your parent’s needs, schedule, budget, and whether they need non-medical help or skilled nursing. For **non-medical in-home support** in Pleasanton, I’d start by interviewing these three:

- **Senior Helpers of Pleasanton** — local office; offers companionship, personal-care assistance, respite, and dementia-related support. [Website](https://www.seniorhelpers.com/ca/pleasanton/locations/pleasanton/)
- **Home Instead** — serves Pleasanton from its Union City office; advertises a broad range of care, including 24-hour support. Its site reports a 4.8 Google rating from 37 reviews, though ratings can change. [Pleasanton service page](https://www.homeinstead.com/home-care/usa/ca/fremont/291/service-area/home-care-in-pleasanton-ca/)
- **Comfort Keepers of Pleasanton** — listed with a 4.8 rating from 19 reviews in one local directory. [Local agency listings](https://www.agingcare.com/local/in-home-care/pleasanton-ca)

Treat ratings as a starting point, not a verdict. Ask each agency for its **California Home Care Organization license**, proof of caregiver screening and insurance, backup coverage, minimum hours, total rates and fees, and how it matches caregivers to clients. Request references and a written care plan, and meet the proposed caregiver before starting. You can verify a California agency through the state’s [Home Care Services Bureau](https://www.cdss.ca.gov/inforesources/community-care/home-care-services).

If your parent needs **nursing or therapy**, rather than help with daily activities, ask their doctor about a Medicare-certified home health agency; that’s a different service from non-medical home care.
